hard_fails.details: Full make test failed in cmd/ailang and internal/apiserver: five existing top-level tests. Debug sink configuration is lost by the new engine clone; no-worker runs add shutdown trace events.
Example manifest statistics remain 229 total / 221 working; actual entries are 231 total / 223 working, coverage 0.9653679653679653.

automated_checks.source_content_hash_command: git ls-tree -r HEAD -- internal cmd std examples/runnable go.mod go.sum Makefile make .stdlib-golden | shasum -a 256

acceptance_criteria.evidence: worker_owner tests cover shared deadline, admission races, fresh cloned registries, shared budget views, global IDs and structured identified failure.
Managed cancellation/lifecycle tests cover retained stdin ownership, queued drain, blocked writes, foreign handles, reaping and descendant kill.
Source cancellation tests cover dual capability/budget checks, natural final chunks, backpressure, descendants and borrowed resource isolation.
Actual CLI/batch PID and PTY matrix plus request/engine/REPL/WS and explicit VM/backend tests exist and passed in the full run; compatibility regressions are separately rejected.
Full tests and verify-examples failed. Independent verdict cannot pass; tracking correctly leaves M5 pending.

documentation_check.design_doc_status: Approved; not yet finalized after independent evaluation

design_fidelity.notes: Owned worker architecture and authority match the approved design. Debug sink inheritance and unrelated no-worker trace compatibility regressions prevent acceptance.

feedback.issue: Engine.SetEffContext clones Debug before server attaches DebugSink to the caller context; requests inherit no sink and all existing request debug lines disappear.
feedback.suggestion: Attach complete Debug configuration before engine cloning. Preserve fresh request accumulators. Verify three existing apiserver debug sink tests and CLI no-caps debug test.

feedback.issue: Ordinary IO-only runs with no worker resources now emit two Process/shutdownWorkers trace events, breaking both existing tail-call goldens and adding unrelated process effects.
feedback.suggestion: Emit receipts for owners that actually admitted workers or require cleanup diagnostics; preserve unchanged traces for no-worker executions. Keep real worker receipts and failure diagnostics.

feedback.issue: Adding two working examples did not update aggregate statistics.
feedback.suggestion: Update only total, working and coverage to calculated values and rerun make verify-examples.

notes: Independent read-only preflight surfaced and implementation fixed source-stop deadline extension, unfinished receipts, original-registry release/reset races, host signal defer ordering and concurrent trace access. Round1 full gates ran once on a clean frozen source head. Automated script prints an invalid duplicate zero in todo_hack_count when grep finds no matches; this report records the directly observed zero without treating script exit zero as test success. Official published-runtime consumer retest is explicitly deferred to delivery; no push/release was performed. Acceptance score uses 13/17 criteria via milestone passes; pending artifacts and long functions deduct code quality. Base score55 plus regression coverage bonus7.
